review.notes: Full-document machine diff: per-page PDF text vs OCR 4-gram containment over all 53 pages, plus whole-file scans for unbalanced code fences (none present), unbalanced inline math delimiters (balanced on every line), spaced digits (none) and Markdown escapes. Low-containment pages were then inspected line-level: p25-27 and p31-34 hold flattened benchmark tables (Table 1 and Table 6 compared cell-by-cell against the PDF text layer, all values equal) and equation-dense method sections (flagged sentence tails confirmed present in LaTeX form); p45-46 contributor lists compared name-by-name (complete, 183 unique names); p49-53 are embedded expert-load heatmap figures whose tick numbers are figure-internal text. The one confirmed repair was visually verified on a 300-dpi render of physical p.45. Reference entries were only machine-scanned (containment >= 0.75 on their pages), not read entry-by-entry.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.45 (300 dpi crop, Research & Engineering column 2 between Guanting Chen and Shangyan Zhou) prints the contributor name as "Shanghao Lu"; the PDF text layer also extracts "Shanghao". OCR normalized it to the real word "Shanghai", altering the printed spelling of the name.

unresolved.evidence: Reference entries were covered only by the machine 4-gram scan (pages not flagged at < 0.75 containment); an entry-by-entry read against the rendered pages has not been done within this review's time budget.

Table 1 (p25-26 region) was probed by random 4-gram sampling and its structure looks intact, but unlike Table 6 it was not compared cell-by-cell; residual risk of a single wrong digit in a flattened HTML cell remains.
